subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue stay open as the combined tracker for structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it across https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while the reply metadata PR or a replacement defines the structured contract and the final-fallback issue defines delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply metadata and no-output halves are fully owned by the linked canonical items.

options.title: Narrow To Control UI Only
options.body: Treat Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI and move remaining channel/runtime semantics elsewhere, accepting that the original structured metadata ask remains out of scope here.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the reply metadata PR or a replacement defines the structured contract and the final-fallback issue defines delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The open maintainer-authored final-fallback contract is the broadest canonical policy item overlapping this issue, though reply metadata ownership is shared.
